name: pose
description: Named pose or action ("happy", "look_up", "viseme_o"): values that replace those of the setup while the pose is active or a driver blends it in. It does not change the setup. It can set any animatable property of any object: bone rotation, vertices of a mouth (with the same number of points they are interpolated), colors, opacity, the active child of a switch...
help: Named pose or action: values that replace the setup ones for some objects, without changing the setup.

values.help: Values the pose sets, per object and property (absolute, like in the setup). Only animatable properties.
values.description: { object_id: { property: value } }. Absolute values, as in the setup. Only animatable properties (for bones: x, y, rotation, scaleX, scaleY).
